title: NNTP input validation coverage audit
description:
Audit every point where NNTP input enters the system (command parser, header parser, article body receiver, Message-ID extractor, group name parser) and verify that: (1) each field has an enforced maximum length, (2) each field rejects invalid characters or formats, (3) no field is used as a SQL value without parameterization, (4) no field is used in a shell command. Produce a checklist table in docs/input_validation_audit.md. File any gaps as new beads issues. Artifact: docs/input_validation_audit.md.

Acceptance:
- Table covers every NNTP input point (list from RFC 3977 command set)
- Each row: input field, max length enforced? format validated? SQL-safe? shell-safe?
- All 'No' entries result in a new beads issue filed
- Audit document committed alongside any fixes
